scope: Live private Photon room: rendered Editor host and two independent Realtime peers. Verifies transport, sender ownership, shared progress, late join and host handoff. Remote rendered UI and physical Android are not verified.

checks.name: Independent clients share an invisible private room
Native player retains local control ownership
Remote replica cannot consume host input
Guest Book starts the original solo ten-minute mapping clock
Late join restores the exact physical relation and shared deadline
A teammate cannot borrow another actor's pending Domain input
Players retain independent pending input selections
Wrong relation deducts ten seconds and charges the authenticated submitting actor
Replayed mapping submission cannot charge another mistake or time penalty
Guest cannot forge a completed mapping snapshot
Timeout keeps the current relation and attributes exactly one mistake to its Book activator
Teammate retry keeps the work and clears stale pending inputs
Remote Undo is rejected away from Codomain
Teammate Undo removes editable team lasers in order
Handoff preserves physical links, exact clock and actor-specific pending input
Duplicate pair request cannot create another laser
Correct relation reaches a paused Book gate and keeps the topic reserved
Shared remaining time stays paused at a solved Book gate
Unfinished Mapping Conduit cannot be exchanged for another topic
Next Book resumes the saved countdown rather than refilling it
Five-pair relation keeps multiple outputs from one input over Photon
Both peers receive the completed ordered-pair relation
Authority protects the initial fixed bijection clue from Undo
Capture clears the owner's pending input and leaves other players free
Captured guest cannot forge a mapping connection
Departure clears pending selection while retaining the player's mistake identity and fixed clue
Shared constrained bijection completes after capture recovery
Network fixture uses the formerly unavailable Relation Only answer
Readonly classification diagram cannot accept additional lasers
Wrong verdict retains its choice and charges the submitting teammate
Relation Only index two completes classification for the room
Wrong property combination and exact time penalty replicate to peers
All five mapping challenges finish and release the next team topic
T8 network flow preserves the other nine topic states and clocks
